note: Simple regularized (winsorize std=4) distinct alphas - robust, low-overfit complements to the mega. All pass structural gates (5/8); below the 2.0 competition bar but useful as low-correlation pool diversifiers.
tradeoff: Simple 1-2 factor regularized alphas cap ~1.3 (robust, won't overfit). Reaching 2.0 requires the diversified ~8-factor mega (higher overfit risk). A 4-factor middle-ground (e.g. value+cfo+pvcorr+gp = 1.31) balances robustness and Sharpe.
